claims.claim: The packaged Human model has attributable, relocatable and integrity-checked provenance.
claims.proof: ASSET_PROVENANCE.md and the adjacent LICENSE.txt identify Quaternius Animated Men Pack under CC0-1.0. The contract stores only assets/characters/quaternius/animated-men/man-casual-a.glb, enforces SHA-256 dad8fa3ca2bc7760892f9ff47f544941179e50acb2aa772cf9f035154a37fc58 and 493196 bytes, and HTTP serves it as model/gltf-binary.

claims.claim: The asset is a real animation substrate rather than a decorative static mesh.
claims.proof: GLB metadata reports one skinned mesh, 31 joints and 11 clips. Seven deterministic contract tests resolve idle, walk, run, punch, sword slash, jump and clap by exporter-neutral suffix and require every class action binding.

claims.claim: The licensed rig appears and transitions through locomotion and the Panzer attack in the live game.
claims.proof: At 1280x720 on ?testSteward=production-rig, the rendered Human reported production / human-casual-a / CC0-1.0 / 31 bones. A bounded W input reported walk. Pan Slap reported slash and attack:slash while the visible model changed to its authored strike; 700ms later direct runtime state returned to idle while retaining the last-action receipt.

claims.claim: Reduced-motion preference does not run the production skeleton through an attack clip.
claims.proof: After enabling the visible Reduced motion checkbox, Pan Slap reported production / reduced-static while the high-contrast action cue remained visible. The setting was restored before handoff.

claims.claim: A missing or rejected production asset cannot gate play.
claims.proof: The deterministic ?testRigFail=1 route made no failed network request, reported fallback / procedural / original-code / qa-forced-safe-fallback, visibly retained the original Human and completed a Pan Slap action.

limitations: One Human body is an integration rung, not final cast breadth; the three classes still share it while retaining distinct code-native weapons, cues and semantic timing.
Blender remains unavailable, so bespoke sculpting, facial animation, grip correction, costumes and LOD authoring were not claimed.
No rolling-frame capture capability was available. Clip names, state transitions and settlement are direct runtime and deterministic evidence; no sub-frame cadence is inferred from screenshots.
Physical gamepad feel and long-session human quality remain unverified.
